## About
Nyberg Enterprises is a family-owned and operated residential roofing company serving Chicago and the northwest suburban area. Andy and Stuart Nyberg learned the business from their father and started out installing roofs by day and selling by night.
At one point they decided to drop advertising altogether. The business kept growing with the help of loyal customers, and the showroom is at a neighbor's house near you. Stuart works out of the N Lowell Ave office in Chicago and Andy out of the Palatine office.
Rated 4.8 on Google from 35 reviews.

## Services
- Tear-offs and re-roofs: Full residential roof replacement, from tearing off the old roof to the new one going on.
- Asphalt and fiberglass shingles: Shingle roofs for houses and garages.
- Slate, tile and wood shakes: Roofing in slate, tile and wood shakes.
- Small repairs: Fixes for leaks and damaged shingles, not just full roofs.
- Skylight installations: Skylights put in as part of your roofing work. Velux skylights are among the brands they link to.
- Modified bitumen rubber flat roofing: Flat roofing in modified bitumen rubber.
- Aluminum gutter, soffit and fascia systems: Gutters, soffit and fascia to finish off the roofline.
- Vinyl, cedar and aluminum siding: Siding in vinyl, cedar or aluminum, handled by their own siding crews.

## FAQ
Q: Are you licensed and insured?
A: Yes. Nyberg is licensed, bonded and insured.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: Chicago and the northwest suburbs, from the office on N Lowell Ave in Chicago and the office on E Sayles Dr in Palatine.

Q: Where is your showroom?
A: Our showroom is at a neighbor's house near you. Ask us and we can point you to work we've done close by.

Q: Can you fix a leak, or do you only do full roofs?
A: We do small repairs too. One reviewer had a leak after storms, and Art came out, found it and fixed it.

Q: What if my project isn't something you handle?
A: Call us and find out. If we can't take it on, we'll give you the name of someone qualified who can.
